latest_open_pr.body:
## Why

Word macros cannot assign supported proofing languages or choose a complex-script font through the existing transactional source adapter. Native font-property ownership also groups independent slots, risking unrelated font metadata during edits.

## Changes

- Add bounded Range.LanguageID and LanguageIDOther setters for 30 explicitly mapped normal-slot language IDs, plus Font.NameBi.
- Preserve separate font/language attributes, explicit inheritance overrides, theme selection and foreign native metadata; guard ambiguous source before mutation.
- Reconcile all captured recent work, including the new Mail conversation core. The intake covers all 305 existing PRs, 26 fork heads and all upstream heads/PRs.
- Preserve incremental checkpoints on this branch. Include source tests and a runnable BAS example.

## Checkpoint status

Compiler checks pass 110 cases; the initial native suite passes 49 cases. The incoming Mail conversation/search slice independently passes 110 tests at its captured head. Final native integration, CLI/MCP, VM/JavaScript agreement and source-bound evidence are in progress; this draft does not claim final acceptance.

The user requested eventual merge to remote main without waiting for the starved free-tier Actions queue. No Actions, workflow, status or check queues are queried or awaited. Final local results and exact limitations will be recorded before merge.
